title: Fire weather planning forecast (NWS)
description: An NWS fire weather planning forecast with discussion and period forecasts. Exercise product: the template adds an exercise banner. Real NWS office, center and station identifiers; the county, places and people are fictional.

sections.description: Sections with a heading and text

heading.description: Section heading as in the product (SYNOPSIS, NEAR TERM...)

examples: Dry air and gusty southwest winds will keep fire danger elevated through the afternoon. A Red Flag Warning is in effect.

examples.text: Dry air and gusty southwest winds will keep fire danger elevated through the afternoon. A Red Flag Warning is in effect.

examples.heading: TODAY
examples.text: Sunny. Highs in the upper 70s. Minimum relative humidity 24 percent. Southwest winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts to 35 mph. Mixing height 4500 feet.

examples.heading: TONIGHT
examples.text: Clear. Lows in the lower 50s. Maximum relative humidity 70 percent. Southwest winds 10 to 15 mph.
